title: Proceso de Construcción de la Sagrada Familia en Vistas de Ingeniería Exquisitas: Viaje de Construcción de 0 a 1
prompt: Using exquisite engineering views, recreate the entire construction process of the Sagrada Familia from 0 to 1, not limited to the building itself, but also including the extraction and transportation of engineering materials. Especially highlighting the most breathtaking aspects of that era. Ultra-wide format, 8K resolution. Technical diagrams showing quarrying, stone carving, transportation methods, scaffolding systems, construction phases, and Antoni Gaudí's innovative structural techniques.
